# Ankit Katole - Software Engineer
> Portfolio, background, technical capabilities, and verified publications for LLMs and AI Agents.

## Summary
Ankit Katole is a backend-focused Software Engineer at Capgemini specializing in enterprise Java (Java 8+), Spring Boot microservices, Apache Kafka event streaming, and resilient distributed systems. He designs high-throughput REST APIs, implements transactional workflow orchestration with Camunda BPM, and builds deterministic LLM integrations using Spring AI.

## Professional Experience
- **Software Engineer at Capgemini** (June 2026 - Present):
  - Engineered order lifecycle management microservices for a mission-critical telecommunications platform processing enterprise-scale telecommunication orders.
  - Implemented event-driven asynchronous messaging pipelines using Apache Kafka for order milestone dispatching and status propagation across downstream provisioning engines.
  - Developed stateless JWT authentication filters, role-based authorization guards, and custom Spring Data JPA queries with MySQL database indexing.
  - Led internal peer workshops on distributed messaging patterns and Kafka offset management.
